body.purpose: Running copy at weight 420 and line height 1.6; story columns cap at 65ch.

shadows.name: suspended-pass
shadows.purpose: Only the suspended draggable portrait pass. Reading surfaces remain flat.

focus.name: action-focus
focus.purpose: Links, buttons, and native summaries. Focused pass flips and disclosure chevrons change immediately.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Source curve for control transforms, entrances, disclosure indicator, and email arrow.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Pass flip and project-media reveal.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Primary/filter transform and background-color feedback; optional 0.97 press scale.

motion.name: pass-spring
motion.purpose: Motion spring release with inherited velocity; x velocity clamped to -1800..1800 and y to -1200..1200. Stops offscreen/hidden; reduced motion jumps to rest.

motion.name: pull-download
motion.purpose: Raw travel from the pointer grab arms one native résumé download only on a noncancelled release. Eligibility is captured at pointerdown; retreat, small/sideways movement, cancellation, and a gesture begun during cooldown do not download. Click/Enter on the hero anchor remains a direct native download.

motion.name: pull-feedback
motion.purpose: The 96px × 3px pill meter uses the surface track and accent fill, with 8px top margin and a left transform origin. Raw pull progress is clamped to 0..1; armed feedback changes the front cord and meter fill to coral, and the hint copy to accent at weight 650. This visual meter is aria-hidden and not focusable.

motion.name: pull-cooldown
motion.purpose: After a committed pull, show ceil(remaining / 1000) seconds in the pass hint and hero file note; scale the meter by remaining / 30,000. Keep the pass draggable/flippable and native links available. Updates run at min(1000ms, remaining), stop while the document is hidden, and synchronize on return; background/offscreen time still counts. Announce only download start and visible ready state.

motion.name: pass-hint
motion.purpose: The bottom-anchored hint follows downward rendered pass movement. ResizeObserver measures the stage, card, and natural hint height; stage min-height is card top + card height + 24px + hint height. The phone hero uses 128px bottom padding for release-rebound clearance.

motion.name: pass-flip
motion.purpose: rotateY(180deg) with ease-in-out; immediate on keyboard focus and reduced motion.

motion.name: face-visibility
motion.purpose: Hide departing pass face halfway through flip; arriving face has 0s delay. No transition for keyboard focus.

motion.name: hero-scroll
motion.purpose: Shallow pass movement during native scrolling; skipped for reduced motion and offscreen state.

motion.name: name-arrive
motion.purpose: Name translates from 100% to rest; second line delayed 80ms. JavaScript and no-preference only.

motion.name: second-name-delay
motion.purpose: Observed delay on the second name line.

motion.name: content-arrive
motion.purpose: Opacity .8 to 1 and translateY(22px) to rest. Replays at 8% visibility after a complete viewport exit. No looping or edge jitter; keyboard and reduced motion skip.

motion.name: media-arrive
motion.purpose: Project-media clip inset(0 0 20% 0) and translateY(16px) to rest, with ease-in-out. Replays after a complete viewport exit and return.

motion.name: portrait-arrive
motion.purpose: Opacity .85, scale(.96), rotate(-2deg) to rest, with ease-out. Replays after a complete viewport exit and return.

motion.name: pointer-disclosure
motion.purpose: Reversible height animation using cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); native immediate behavior for keyboard/reduced motion.

motion.name: disclosure-chevron
motion.purpose: Rotation with ease-out; immediate for keyboard focus/reduced motion.

motion.name: contact-arrow
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover translates 5px right and 5px up with ease-out; no-preference only.

motion.name: tools-drift
motion.purpose: Right-to-left translateX(-50%) of duplicated track. Hover pauses it; pointer leave resumes it. No manual pause control. Suspend automatically offscreen and in hidden documents. Static wrapping collection for reduced motion/no JavaScript.

assets.mediaPolicy: Owner-supplied pass/certificates, actual poster-rendered extension screens, actual Gaffaly browser capture; authored investment-lakehouse diagram recorded in assets/README.md.

evidence.scope: The local pull-download extension has 21 passing interaction groups at 1440, 1280, 768, 390, and 320px in output/playwright/report.json. Coverage includes actual PDF download, the full 30-second cooldown under a virtual clock, re-arming, native keyboard fallback, Chromium CDP touch cancellation/pull/outside scrolling, 200% root text scaling, no JavaScript, direct file:// use, repeated reveals, and hover-only logo pausing. Observer runtime checks cover edge stability, cleanup, and keyboard/wheel input.
evidence.limitations: Concept-seed and detector attempts exited 127 under the protected-cache constraint. No successful Impeccable seed/roll/check-seed, detector, approved image comp, or actual-phone hardware test is claimed. Phone gesture evidence is Chromium CDP touch emulation. The separate Taste draw has no Impeccable seed authority.
evidence.reviewStatus: ship: the reviewer scored the sole mobile caption/meter containment fix resolved. This disposition covers that fix only. Both phone captures show complete feedback; 48 real rebound samples retain at least 31.10px clearance at 390px and 18.97px at 320px. No fix-batch regressions observed; no physical-phone test claimed.

narrative.overview:
Soft-white space, ocean-blue fields, and coral actions frame a substantial Archivo voice. The existing portrait becomes a suspended pass with a real tether, direct manipulation, and a reversible face. This descriptive label records the implemented, owner-requested lanyard; it does not imply a new metaphor workshop or approved image comp.

The surrounding page stays open and readable. Rounded controls act within flat, square records; actual project screens, an authored architecture diagram, owner photographs, and genuine tool logos provide the visual evidence. This document records the finished implementation in `styles.css`, `index.html`, and `script.js`; product facts remain in `PRODUCT.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Soft-white and paper-white reading surfaces with ocean text and coral action accents.
One locally hosted variable typeface with fluid display and body roles.
A physical portrait pass whose shadow, tether, and spring express suspension.
Pill controls alongside square, independently expandable project records.
Genuine local imagery and brand logos, with static and reduced-motion reading paths.

rules.name: The Ocean Field Rule
rules.body: Experience and contact pair ocean backgrounds with paper text, icons, and inherited focus outlines; selection reverses that pair.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use the locally hosted Archivo weight and width axes for hierarchy, retaining the sans-serif fallback and native text semantics.

rules.name: The Suspended Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep material shadow on the suspended pass; related reading surfaces use the implemented flat tonal hierarchy.

dos: **Do** preserve the soft-white, ocean-blue, and coral roles recorded in the frontmatter.
**Do** use locally hosted Archivo, pill actions, square project records, and the fluid gutter and section tokens.
**Do** reserve the material shadow for the physical pass and keep its tether, keyboard face state, and native touch-scroll intent intact.
**Do** keep content visible by default, independent native disclosures, explicit filter states, visible focus, and static/reduced-motion alternatives.
**Do** use genuine owner/project imagery and locally hosted brand marks with their recorded provenance and descriptive text.
donts: **Don't** carry the obsolete cobalt/sand palette or square action controls into new surfaces for this redesign.
**Don't** turn the pass's shadow and rounded shell into a default treatment for reading surfaces.
**Don't** make essential content depend on motion, JavaScript-only rendering, dragging, or a moving rail.
**Don't** turn functional dates, captions, or table headers into an invented decorative label system.
**Don't** treat generated color ramps, a separate Taste draw, or unavailable Impeccable checks as approved palette or seed authority.
